sourceText:
Batter Fried Zucchini
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 23, 2009 - 12:37am

Ingredients




1 teaspoon baking powder
1/2 cup flour
1/4 teaspoon salt
1/4 teaspoon pepper
1/2 teaspoon garlic powder
1 teaspoon parsley flakes
1/4 cup Romano or Parmesan cheese
1 egg, beaten
1 med. zucchini
Milk

Preparation

1 Wash and slice 1 medium zucchini. Combine all dry ingredients. Add the egg and slowly add enough milk to make a pancake like batter. Make sure it is not too thick or thin. Dip zucchini in batter to coat. Fry in hot oil. Drain on paper towels.
